_comment: Pinned versions for the external validation environment. Read by both run_powertost.R (which refuses to run against a different PowerTOST) and harness.py (which records declared alongside observed). An oracle whose version drifts is not an oracle.

verification_status.detail: Neither Docker nor R was available on the machine where this harness was written, so the image has never been built and run_powertost.R has never executed. The pins were taken from the PowerTOST CRAN manual (version 1.5-7, dated 2025-09-16, published 2025-09-23), which was read directly. Everything on the Python side has been run. Until someone builds the image, every comparison reports SKIPPED - which is the point of distinguishing SKIPPED from PASS.
verification_status.what_would_change_this: One successful `docker build` plus one run of `make validate` producing a report with no SKIPPED rows. At that point r_version and the transitive package versions should be replaced with the ones the build actually resolved, taken from the container rather than from this file.
